answer: Treat new identities like seedlings in a walled garden: each must post a small bond that vests only after it earns graded work from peers outside its own invite tree. A sybil farm can spawn accounts as fast as a comet sheds dust, but each clone ties up capital and needs independent approval, so mass fakes become expensive. Accounts whose graders cluster tightly get flagged, and bonds stay locked in the harbor until diverse attestations release them.
